title: Refit a silicone teat and fasten the collar of a baby bottle
instruction: Fit the teat and screw the collar onto the bottle, then release the assembly.
context: After washing, a feeding bottle must be reassembled. A collar can catch the bottle thread while part of the flexible teat flange remains folded away from the rim.
setup: Three loose parts on the calibrated dual-YAM table: a rigid plastic bottle (71 mm tall, 60 mm body diameter), a screw collar (62 mm outside diameter, 44 mm aperture) and a silicone teat (about 56 mm across its flange). From the base midpoint, in mm forward and left, place the upright bottle at (304,18), collar skirt down at (318,112) and teat flange down at (301,-131). A fixed 20 g internal load represents a 20 mL prefill.
scoring: 0 if held or the teat fit fails. 0.5 if the outlet projects outward and the teat stays captured all around during a collar-only lift. Both rise at least 20 mm and the teat clears the table by 20 mm for 1 s. 1 also requires both lugs and the whole rim to stay seated throughout the lift, with bottle rise and clearance each at least 20 mm for 1 s. Physically invert the 20 mL prefilled bottle for 10 s. Both seams must stay dry. Normal outlet flow is allowed. Repeat inconclusive inspections.
run_limit: 2,400 actions at 20 Hz (120 seconds). The post-release grading lift is outside the policy budget.
reset_notes: Start with three separate parts dry on the outside and the bottle upright. Protect the work surface, prefill the bottle with 20 mL of clear water and keep the shared grippers dry. Perform the physical inspection over a separate catch tray.
fidelity: Free rigid bottle and collar with modeled load-bearing thread flanks, a deformable silicone teat and a fixed internal mass. Dimensions and material response approximate a Philips Avent Natural Response assembly. Grading uses rim contact and collar retention as mechanical proxies. Liquid flow, valve behavior and watertightness have not been validated.
scores: Dream-1 scored 0.0 in all 2,400 actions (120 s) when regraded. The released collar-only example scores 0.5 in 962 actions (48.1 s). The known-layout full demo scores 1.0 in 1,769 actions (88.45 s).
